GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride

South Burlington, VT · Road

GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride is a road group ride in South Burlington, VT. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Wheeler Dirt Lot. About 23–28 miles, speed-based groups of 12 or fewer.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: speed-based groups of 12 or fewer. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride group ride

A 28-mile loop through Shelburne and Charlotte with about 1,150 feet of climbing. Groups of twelve or fewer form by speed; the fastest starts first. Faster groups may not wait. The last group regroups and tries not to leave anyone. You need to hold 15 mph to fit in.
